Photograph: Ute Grabowsky/Photothek/Getty Images Apple Gmail and Apple’s apps suffer outages days after major Microsoft disruptions 
 Reports come on heels of major disruptions in technological infrastructure in the US and worldwide
 Anna Betts and Blake Montgomery Tue 17 Nov 2026 14.06 EST Last modified on Tue 17 Nov 2026 14.08 EST Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Disruptions hit Gmail and Apple’s iPhone apps, such as Apple Pay and iCloud, on Tuesday, according to thousands of users reporting problems to Downdetector . Apple’s own system status page shows outages in the App Store and Apple Music and issues with iCloud logins, the accounts where users store their photos, messages and other digital materials.
 The outage reports come on the heels of major disruptions in technological infrastructure, particularly in the US but also worldwide, that range from air traffic control systems to email accounts. The widespread outages began in earnest last week when Microsoft Outlook users across the globe could not access their email accounts or other critical Microsoft Office applications. The day after that outage began, the US Department of Transportation grounded all flights nationwide in response to a communication system malfunction.
 Apple did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
